01

“We took from the prophets their covenant”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 33:7).

774
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 774: 1: 1

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
774: 1:1. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Said, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
"We took from the prophets their covenant": He said, their covenant concerning their peoples (verse 7).
العربية
774: 1: 1 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عن سعيد عن بن عباس في قوله أخذنا من النبيين ميثاقهم قال ميثاقهم على قومهم (الآية 7) .

02

“Fleeing will not benefit you if you flee from death or killing, and…”

Two explanations transmitted from Abū Razīn (Q 33:16).

775
Explanation from Abū Razīn No. 775: 2: 3

Abū Razīn

English
Transmission wording
775: 2:3. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu Razin, who said:
Rabi ibn Khuthaym recited this verse: "Fleeing will not benefit you if you flee from death or killing, and then you will not be given enjoyment except for a little": He said, between them and that is [only] a little [the Arabic is garbled here] (verse 16).
العربية
775: 2: 3 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي رُزَيْنٍ قال قرأ الربيع بن خيثم هذه الآية لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لا تمتعون إلا قليلا قال بينهم وبين كذلك القليل (الآية 16) .
Edition record 371480 · p. 241Link to report ↗

04

“O Messenger of God, men are mentioned and women are not”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:35).

778
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 778: 5: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
778: 5:2. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
Umm Salama said, "O Messenger of God, men are mentioned and women are not." So there was revealed: "Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, ⦗p. 242⦘ the believing men and believing women," to the end of the verse (verse 35).
العربية
الإسناد
778: 5: 2 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ قلت أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يُذْكَرُ الرِّجَالُ وَلَا تُذْكَرُ النِّسَاءُ فنزلت المسلمين والمسلمات
"report__pb">⦗p. 242⦘ والمؤمنين والمؤمنات إلى آخر الآية. (الآية 35) .
